name: Boucles Irene
ligne: Triangulaires, les boucles Irene bordent leur pierre, en serti clos, d’un halo de petits diamants.
description: Boucles Irene, or blanc, jaune ou rose 750/1000, serties chacune en clos d’un diamant rond, dans un halo de diamants ronds. Pierres de centre aussi proposées en émeraude, rubis ou saphir.
details: Or blanc 750 ‰, Or jaune 750 ‰, Or rose 750 ‰
Serties chacune en clos d’un diamant rond, dans un halo de diamants ronds

en.ligne: The Irene earrings are triangular, their stone in a rub-over setting bordered by a halo of small diamonds.
en.description: Irene earrings in 18ct white, yellow or rose gold, each set with a round diamond in a rub-over setting, within a halo of round diamonds. Centre stones also available in emerald, ruby or sapphire.

it.ligne: Gli orecchini Irene sono triangolari: la pietra, a castone, ha un contorno di piccoli diamanti.
it.description: Orecchini Irene in oro bianco, giallo o rosa 18 kt, ciascuno con un diamante rotondo a castone e contorno di diamanti rotondi. Pietre centrali disponibili anche in smeraldo, rubino o zaffiro.
